items.name: Arteries
items.text: Carry blood away from the heart.

items.name: Capillaries
items.text: Tiny, thin-walled vessels where substances pass between blood and cells.

items.name: Veins
items.text: Carry blood back towards the heart.

flow.does: Explain the different jobs of three vessel types; 6 minutes.

look_at.shows: Arteries leading to capillaries and then veins.

picture.shows: Rock specimens beside a magnifying glass, a hand feeling a surface and a coin making a scratch test
picture.subject: generic

items.name: Appearance
items.text: Look for colours, layers, crystals and grains.

items.name: Texture
items.text: Feel whether the surface is rough or smooth.

items.name: Hardness
items.text: Harder rocks are more difficult to scratch.

flow.does: Introduce simple ways to compare rocks
flow.shape: a set of kinds or examples

look_at.shows: Rock samples being observed, touched and tested for scratching

sides.title: Arteries
sides.text: Carry blood away from the heart.

picture.shows: A thick-walled artery with a flow arrow directed away from a small heart symbol

sides.title: Capillaries
sides.text: Exchange substances through very thin walls.

picture.shows: A fine capillary beside body cells, with arrows crossing its thin wall in both directions
A vein with an internal valve and a flow arrow directed towards a small heart symbol

look_at.shows: Vessel structure and flow direction for each vessel type

sides.title: Shield
sides.text: Runny lava travels far, building broad, gentle slopes. Gas escapes easily; eruptions are usually less explosive.

picture.shows: A shield volcano in profile with broad gentle slopes and a long thin lava flow
picture.subject: generic

sides.title: Composite
sides.text: Thicker lava travels less far, building steep slopes. Trapped gas makes eruptions more explosive; ash adds layers.

picture.shows: A composite volcano in profile with steep slopes, short thick lava flows and an ash plume
picture.subject: generic

flow.does: Link lava flow, volcano shape and eruption style; 7 minutes.

look_at.shows: A broad shield volcano beside a steep composite volcano, with contrasting lava flows.
